name: theme-bridge
title: Designme theme bridge
description: Opt-in: the components take their colours and corners from a shadcn/ui or Tailwind v4 theme (--background, --card, --popover, --foreground, --muted-foreground, --border, --input, --ring, --secondary, --primary, --primary-foreground, --destructive, --chart-1, --chart-2, --chart-3, --chart-4, --chart-5, --radius).
docs: Import components/designme/theme-bridge.css after the components' CSS (for example in your layout). It changes only the designme components.
